name: 普保羅
objective:
This course helps senior students in the Department of Interaction Design organize and present their previous design projects into a professional portfolio. The course covers project selection, design storytelling, process documentation, visual layout, personal branding, résumé preparation, self-introduction, online portfolio development, and final portfolio presentation.

Through lectures, case studies, group discussions, individual critiques, and staged presentations, students will develop a portfolio suitable for job applications, internships, graduate school applications, or freelance opportunities. Special emphasis will be placed on clearly communicating problem definition, user research, design process, interaction logic, prototyping, testing, and final outcomes.
schedule:
Week 1 Course Introduction and Portfolio Positioning
Week 2 Portfolio Case Studies: Interaction Design, UI/UX, Digital Media, Installation Projects
Week 3 Personal Skill Mapping and Project Selection
Week 4 Portfolio Structure: Homepage, About, Project Categories, Contact
Week 5 Project Storytelling: From Design Problem to Final Outcome
Week 6 Design Process Documentation: Research, Sketches, Flowcharts, Prototypes, Testing
Week 7 Visual Layout Design: Typography, Color, Grid, Image Style
Week 8 Portfolio Draft Presentation and Individual Feedback
Week 9 Midterm report
Week 10 Presentation Strategies for UI/UX and Interaction Projects
Week 11 Documentation of Videos, Motion Prototypes, and Interactive Demos
Week 12 Personal Branding and Résumé Design
Week 13 Behance、Notion、Wix、Webflow、Online Portfolio Platforms: Behance, Notion, Wix, Webflow, Personal Website
Week 14 English Portfolio and International Presentation
Week 15 Interview Presentation and Self-Introduction Practice
Week 16 Portfolio Revision and One-on-One Consultation
Week 17 Final Rehearsal: Full Portfolio Presentation
Week 18 Final Presentation and Critique
scorePolicy:
Participation and Attendance 20%
Weekly and Stage Assignments 25%
Midterm report 20%
Final Portfolio 25%
Final Presentation 10%
